args.command:
bead create --title "Locate behavioral sidecar files in ~/.agentscribe/sessions/" --description "## Task
Find all behavioral signals sidecar files in the AgentScribe sessions directory.

## Requirements
- List all files in ~/.agentscribe/sessions/ directory
- Identify which files are behavioral sidecars (not session logs)
- Count the total number of sidecar files found

## Acceptance Criteria
- Complete directory listing of ~/.agentscribe/sessions/
- Identification of which files are behavioral sidecar files
- Count of total sidecar files" --label split-child
args.description: Create child bead 1: Locate sidecar files

## Requirements
- Examine the filenames found in the previous step
- Identify the pattern: is it behavioral_signals.json or .behavioral.json?
- Check for any variations or inconsistencies in the naming
- Document the exact pattern observed

## Acceptance Criteria
- Clear statement of the actual naming pattern used
- Examples of actual filenames found
- Note any variations or inconsistencies" --label split-child

- Identify what filename pattern the code expects
- Compare code expectations with the actual pattern found
- Note any discrepancies

## Acceptance Criteria
- Documentation of what the code expects
- Comparison matrix: code expectation vs actual reality
- Clear identification of any discrepancies" --label split-child
args.description: Create child bead 3: Compare pattern with code

- Update BEHAVIORAL_SIDECAR_NAMING.md if needed

## Acceptance Criteria
- Complete documentation of findings
- Clear statement of the actual naming convention
- Any code fixes or documentation updates completed" --label split-child
